Description: 30 nodes, fixed: 3 high-EconomicWeight 'hub' nodes joined first, among 27 ordinary ones, each node keeping only 4 outbound peers (real Bitcoin's default is 8). Demonstrates PEER TOPOLOGY: the hubs accumulate far more inbound connections than an ordinary node purely because every later-joining node's weighted peer picks favor them, so blocks tend to relay through the hubs hop by hop rather than every node talking directly to every other node.
